resources.string: 53 objects: Ceres, Enceladus, Vega, Deneb, Altair and the Southern Cross join the catalogue.
Scenario time speed up to 3600×, with restart, active-only or continuous resumption.
Close approaches within 1.5° at the same instant appear in paths, captures and exports.
Sort by distance from Earth and open an object’s Observatory directly from the catalogue.
More consistent settings, landscape cards, daily-path symbols and a 15-minute screensaver option.
Graphics pack 1.4: 29 external WebP images with individual downloads, integrity checks and offline cache.
